title: Yellow Tender Slovakian Onion Pasta
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring tender onions and a rich pasta water emulsion, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is also ayurvedic rajasic friendly. It is a salty and comforting meal that is easy to prepare.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced yellow onions to the skillet and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and lightly caramelized.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter to the skillet and stir to combine.
Sprinkle the all purpose flour over the onions and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the pasta water to the skillet, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, until it has thickened into a rich emulsion.
Stir in the grated grana padano cheese until it is fully melted and the sauce is smooth.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the onion sauce.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
